flow.caption_zh:
我相信
這火山溶岩環繞的瀑布
一定飄浮著許多故事寓言
在光影交織中忽隱忽現

zh: 在峽谷遠端湍起濛濛煙霧
不能抵擋咫尺之外的喧嘩
卻有一份寄託心情的安詳
en: A waterfall surging and falling
At the far end of the canyon, mist rises in swirling rapids
Sparse and unfamiliar
As if a lightly tinted ink-wash painting
Unable to hold back the clamor just beyond arm's reach
Yet holds a peace in which the heart finds its repose
Gradually dispersing into the vast distance

zh: 我試圖像綠草一般思索
en: Between rock and mist
I try to think like the green grass
Believing that where there is light, one can transcend
Then one can trace back through the mottled years
Trying to tell who is guiding me
Like flowing water, passing on and on
Silently piercing through
The hidden cares of icebergs and snow peaks
The warp and weft of the earth's veins

zh: 竟似當年遺失的蠟筆盒
落到寒意陣陣的北極圈
en: That rainbow spanning the waterfall
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet
It seems just like the crayon box lost long ago
At its tail end still hangs the past of childhood
After long years have passed, only then do I know
What is lost has not entirely vanished
It is from the hot, humid Tropic of Cancer
Falling to the Arctic Circle's waves of cold

zh: 相對於奔騰喧嘩的瀑布
en: In contrast to the roaring, tumbling waterfall
A snowy grassland spanning the horizon
Calm, wordless
Like an unrolled scroll of painting and calligraphy
Letting the slanting light soak in, the floating clouds cast their shadows
Only feeling the autumn colors arriving from afar
Faintly, a song .....
Old temple, cold mountain, a spring murmuring on
Blue-and-white porcelain, clear tea, a life of quiet simplicity

points.zh: 黃金瀑布 (Gullfoss) 位於冰島首都雷克雅未克 (Reykjavik) 東北125 公里處，和Thingvellir National Park以及 Geysers of Haukadalur 形成有名的冰島“黃金旅遊圈”。黃金瀑布是冰島最大的斷層峽谷瀑布，也是歐洲水量沖激力最強的瀑布，以水霧迷濛，艷陽下呈現多層彩虹，以及少女的動人事蹟而使人流連。黃金瀑布寬2500公尺，高70公尺，氣勢壯偉，湍急的水流連落二階，奔騰而下，注入峽谷，發出振耳欲聾的轟隆聲。陽光照射下，蒸騰的水霧，化成金光閃爍的點點水滴，配上時隱時現亮艷的彩虹，彷彿整個瀑布是用黃金碎片綴舖而成，“黃金瀑布”因而得名。
points.en: Gullfoss (Golden Falls) is located 125 kilometers northeast of Reykjavik, Iceland's capital, and together with Þingvellir National Park and the Geysers of Haukadalur forms Iceland's celebrated 'Golden Circle' tourist route. Gullfoss is Iceland's largest canyon waterfall and Europe's most powerful waterfall by force of water impact, renowned for its misty spray, the multi-layered rainbows that appear under sunlight, and the touching story of a young woman associated with it. The falls are 2,500 meters wide and 70 meters high; the powerful current cascades down over two successive steps, plunging into the canyon with a deafening roar. Under sunlight, the rising mist turns into glittering, golden droplets, paired with a vivid rainbow that appears and disappears, as if the entire waterfall were assembled from fragments of gold — hence the name 'Golden Falls.'
